items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, Lou Costello. Yeah. Lou Lou was playing the drum? Yeah, it says Lou on the drum.

ctx.x: This was at the Thorngarals. Frank Clark played a pretty good piano. Yeah, and this kid here was AJ Salaci. That was the last time I used him once and I was seeing old Gene and Bazley on the drum.
Oh, Lou Costello. Yeah. Lou Lou was playing the drum? Yeah, it says Lou on the drum. I'll get those Lou. Frank Clark on the piano. Clark Clark, yeah.
He used to tune piano. He was a professor in college and put it down there. There's Dick Allen right here.
